purpose: Complete the same-source Electricity/Traffic H96 strong-baseline matrix by adding RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 to the already frozen candidate/DLinear/NLinear extension.
research_question: Under the frozen current-source H96 contract, how do five additional standard baselines compare with the already executed MambaTSv3 AutoCon candidate on Electricity and Traffic?
evidence_boundary: Validation-only continuation. Every job skips the test loader; no test metric, prediction, streaming metric, or test release may be generated or inspected.
claim_boundary: Results can be joined with the candidate/DLinear/NLinear extension only if the strict reader verifies identical source hash, data fingerprints, configurations, and paired seed coordinates. The joined matrix remains validation-only.

required_before_launch: verify Electricity and Traffic fingerprints and the complete 30-job expansion
retain the candidate/DLinear/NLinear plan's common budget and paired seeds unchanged
keep skip_test=true and save_predictions=false for every job
create one immutable source snapshot and fresh output root

selection_contract.freeze_rule: All baseline identities, data split, optimizer, scheduler, budget, normalization, and seeds match the companion candidate/DLinear/NLinear extension; no held-out signal or retuning is permitted.

capacity_fairness_contract.common_public_budget: All arms share chronological split, M features, sequence length, horizon, optimizer, scheduler, batch size, epochs, patience, and normalization.
capacity_fairness_contract.baseline_boundary: These five baselines receive no AutoCon, representation-fusion, ACF-memory, graph, or candidate-only Mamba setting.

phases.name: remaining_baselines_h96_validation
phases.purpose: Same-contract high-dimensional RLinear, PatchTST, TimesNet, iTransformer, and Mamba2 baselines.

comparison_contract.reporting_rule: Only the dedicated joined reader may combine this continuation with the companion candidate/DLinear/NLinear artifact after exact source and contract checks.

stopping_rules: Do not promote a dataset to a held-out plan if the candidate is more than 2% worse than its strongest registered baseline.
Do not produce or inspect held-out artifacts.
